details.name: VI Peel
details.description: A medium-depth chemical treatment designed to improve skin tone and  texture, while stimulating collagen. Suitable for all skin tones, including darker complexions, with peeling typically lasting up to one week
details.benefits:
Fades hyperpigmentation
Refines texture and pores
Clears acne and reduces scars

details.name: BioRePeel
details.description: This innovative, two-phase trichloroacetic acid (TCA) chemical peel rejuvenates the skin and improves active breakouts, post-acne marks, sun damage, uneven skin tone with minimal downtime.

details.name: Dermaplaning
details.description: This technique is a specialized exfoliating treatment that uses a sterile surgical blade to gently remove dead skin cells and fine facial hair,revealing  a smoother complexion.

details.name: Microchanneling/AquaGold
details.description: This advanced treatment utilizes ultra-fine, 24-karat gold-plated needles to seamlessly infuse a customized cocktail into the skin's superficial layer,delivering an array of targeted,skin-refining benefits.

details.name: Lymphatic Drainage
details.description: A gentle specialized massage technique designed to stimulate the lymphatic system, reducing fluid retention and accelerating toxin removal.

details.name: Light Emmiting Diode (LED) Therapy
details.description: This clinically proven spectrum of wavelengths stimulates cellular repair,calms inflammation, and eradicates acne-causing bacteria.

details.name: DermaElectroPoration
details.description: This needle-free, intracellular transdermal delivery method drives both, low and high-molecular weight serums deep into the skin to replenish collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid.

details.name: Microcurrent and Biosonix Ultrasound
details.description: Advanced technology designed to visibly tone and lift the skin at a cellular level. Microcurrent uses low-voltage electrical currents to stimulate and contour facial muscles,  while Biosonix Ultrasound delivers targeted sound waves to boost cellular metabolism and product penetration for a firmer, more youthful appearance.
